topic-playback.evidence: Overall the best music app in terms of selection and features, however, considering how long Spotify has been around my experience has been very buggy. At some point someone was able to fully control my Spotify account and I could not kick them off. More recently, the app didn't let me access any of my downloaded songs

Great app poorly executed. Will not stop synching over cellular data despite cellular data unchecked. Always consuming my data and and synching at the most inconvenient of times. Seriously considering to uninstall and unsubscribe. Can't believe Spotify still haven't improved the app after all this time.
